payload.title: Validate tenant-aware two-stage publication routing preparation
payload.description:
Feature: Separate publication routing stages
Scenario: Prepare without editorial choices
Given the domain, SaaS account, publication, central grant and section criteria are not yet supplied
When an operator validates a prepared site plan
Then it remains inactive and lists unresolved fields without inventing them
Scenario: Preserve two stages and tenant provenance
Given distinct owner and consumer SaaS accounts and a consumer-owned section router
When a matched central output is handed to section routing
Then source revision, publication, central decision and owner/consumer identities are retained
And feedback and undecided labels remain separate
Scenario: Refuse implicit tenant reuse
Given central owner account differs from the publication account
When the internal router is bound to the central owner or the same central engine
Then validation rejects the plan.
